mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "O" marks the center of the indicated circle. Right image: The symbol "O" marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes.
Rationales: The left occurrence is O at the internal junction of the dashed height and base radius. The right occurrence is O where the real and imaginary axes cross. The left placement shows that the symbol marks the center of the indicated circle, while the right placement shows that it marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes.
